subject: Make-good: missed demo & next steps
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@parkviewhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Make-good: missed demo & next steps
Attachments: 10-05-demo-agenda.pdf, discovery-notes-parkview.txt

Sarah —

We missed our 9:00 PT demo this morning; hope everything is ok on your end. Wanted to do a quick make-good so you don’t lose momentum. Below are the key notes I captured during discovery and two tight slots we can lock today/this week if either works for you. If neither fits, tell me the best 30–45 minute window and I’ll work around it.

Quick discovery recap (from our call last week):
- Primary use case: clinical-notes summarization and on-call triage routing.
- Pilot scope: 2 hospitals, ~120 clinicians, internal EHR integrations required.
- Security/regulatory: data residency preference in us-east, SOC 2 expected by Q1.
- Success metric: reduce physician documentation time by 20–30% in pilot.

Actionable next steps I’m proposing:
1) Technical deep-dive + demo (45 min) — I’ll walk through integration surface, latency/throughput expectations, and quantization tradeoffs. Lauren (solutions engineer) will join to answer infra questions.
2) Confirmation + calendar lock — because earlier session slipped, can you confirm within 24 hours so we can secure a dedicated SE seat?

Tight slot options (pick one):
- Option A: Today, 2:00–2:45 PM PT / 5:00–5:45 PM ET
- Option B: Tomorrow, 11:00–11:45 AM PT / 2:00–2:45 PM ET

Please reply with: 1) chosen option, 2) attendees (we’ll need an engineer and an IT/security lead if possible), and 3) any must-cover agenda items (SSO, data retention, latency SLOs, PII handling).

I attached a 1-page demo agenda and my quick discovery notes for reference. If you prefer, we can also do a 15-minute pre-call to align objectives before the demo.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this back on calendar.

—
Michael Grant
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0187
From: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@parkviewhealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Make-good: missed demo & next steps

Hi Michael —

Apologies for the no-show this morning. We had an urgent staffing issue and I got pulled into an incident. Really appreciate the follow-up and the concise recap — that matches what our team needs.

Available window I can commit to: Thursday, Oct 7, 10:00–10:45 AM ET (that’s 7:00–7:45 AM PT) — I realize that is outside your suggested slots. If you can do that, I’ll confirm and add Tom Blake (IT) and procurement on the invite.

If Thursday doesn’t work, Option B (tomorrow 2:00 PM ET) could work for Tom instead of me — he’s the one who will need to be comfortable with SSO and network configs.

Primary asks for the demo:
- Show the EHR ingest pattern and how you handle incremental syncs
- Clarify encryption at rest and key management options
- Rough cost-per-token estimate for pilot volume

I’ll await your confirmation and appreciate looping in your SE.

Best,
Sarah
Director, Clinical Digital Innovation
Parkview Health
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@parkviewhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Make-good: missed demo & next steps

Thanks for the note, Sarah — glad the recap landed.

Thursday Oct 7, 10:00–10:45 AM ET works for our team. We’ll lock that slot. To reduce no-shows and make sure the right folks are prepared, two quick asks:
1) Can you confirm Tom Blake and procurement on the invite? That way we can surface SSO and contract timing live.
2) Please confirm by EOD tomorrow (10/06) so I can reserve a dedicated SE seat and the extended demo environment — if we don’t hear back by then, we’ll release the slot and propose new times.

Lauren, Dev — can you both join at Thu 10:00 ET? Lauren will cover infra and latency SLOs; Dev can prep the EHR adaptor discussion. If helpful, we’ll do a 15-minute pre-call 30 minutes before the demo to align objectives.

On agenda items: we’ll address incremental syncs, encryption/KMS options, and a ballpark cost estimate for pilot throughput. I’ll attach the one-pager to the calendar invite and share a short runbook for the pilot checklist.

Quoted for context:
> On 2026-10-05 at 11:02 AM, Sarah Jensen wrote:
> \u201cAvailable window I can commit to: Thursday, Oct 7, 10:00–10:45 AM ET...\u201d

Looking forward to locking this in — I’ll send a provisional invite now and switch to a confirmed invite once you reply.

—
Michael

Michael —

Confirmed. I added Tom and procurement; calendar invite is live. Link: https://calendar.app/g/parkview-demo-1007

Tom will focus on SSO/KMS and procurement will want the rough pilot pricing. I will be there for the first 30 minutes and Tom will stay on for Q&A.

Thanks for accommodating the schedule and for the clear agenda. See you Thursday Oct 7 at 10:00 AM ET.

Regards,
